examples.question:
Write a project proposal.
Project: Customer Portal Redesign
Client: NorthBridge Financial
Budget: £55,000
Timeline: 12 weeks
Objective: Redesign the customer-facing portal to reduce support calls and improve self-service rates.
Deliverables: UX audit report, new design system, rebuilt frontend, user testing report
Out of scope: Backend API changes, mobile app
examples.answer:
PROJECT PROPOSAL
Project: Customer Portal Redesign
Client: NorthBridge Financial
Prepared: March 2026

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
This proposal outlines the redesign of NorthBridge Financial's customer portal with the goal of reducing inbound support volume and increasing self-service completion rates. The project will deliver a modern, accessible frontend built on a new design system, backed by user research and testing.

OBJECTIVES
- Reduce support call volume by improving task discoverability
- Increase self-service completion rate by 30%
- Establish a reusable design system for future development

SCOPE
The project covers UX audit, design, and frontend development only. Backend API changes and the mobile app are explicitly out of scope.

DELIVERABLES
1. UX audit report with prioritised findings
2. Component-level design system (Figma)
3. Rebuilt portal frontend
4. User testing report (2 rounds)

TIMELINE OVERVIEW
Weeks 1-2:   Discovery and UX audit
Weeks 3-5:   Design and stakeholder review
Weeks 6-10:  Frontend development
Weeks 11-12: User testing and handover

BUDGET SUMMARY
Total: £55,000
30% on project start | 40% at design sign-off | 30% on delivery
